nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Explicit, duplicate-checked registries for agents, skills, and agent-facing tools, computing effective permissions as the union of an agent profile and its skills.

nodes.name: routing.py
nodes.summary: Provider-agnostic model routing that resolves capability requests (simple, research, reasoning, vision, coding, verification) to configured local models via pluggable ModelProvider implementations, defaulting to Ollama.

nodes.name: skills.py
nodes.summary: Declarative initial skill definitions (corpus research, memory research, evidence synthesis, tailoring) each declaring required tools, permissions, preferred model capability, and risk level.

nodes.name: tools.py
nodes.summary: Default agent-facing tool handlers covering corpus search/fetch, memory read/write/candidate, workouts, documents, knowledge, people, filesystem and shell work, each with a permission/risk profile, bound into an AgentToolRegistry by build_default_agent_tools.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Primary CLI entry point exposing search, document/event/conversation ingestion, memory curation and review, people indexing, workout import, embedding backfill, and agent chat; also hosts the build_agent/build_chat_memory/build_chat_people construction paths shared with the HTTP layer.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Environment-driven configuration dataclasses for optional model backends: embedding model, retrieval mode, vision model and prompt version, API host/port, and Ollama base URL, with explicit load_*_settings readers and no fallback chain.

nodes.name: conversation_ingestion.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates idempotent ingestion of Gemini and ChatGPT conversation exports into ConversationStore, bridging source loaders and persistence with typed summary objects.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the document ingestion domain surface: canonicalization, chunking, classification, embedding, extraction and structured models.

nodes.name: canonical.py
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes a SourceRecord into a Document using stable identity and content-hash helpers, preserving source-specific facts verbatim in metadata.

nodes.name: effective_permissions
nodes.summary: Computes the union of an agent's own permissions and its skills' required permissions, skipping unknown skills.

nodes.name: build_default_skill_registry
nodes.summary: Builds the SkillRegistry containing the initial declarative skill set.

nodes.name: _memory_scopes
nodes.summary: Resolves memory scope filters from tool arguments (scope, scope_id, execution_id, agent_id) for policy-gated memory reads.

nodes.name: _memory_write_handler
nodes.summary: Policy-gated memory write tool: validates candidate memory and persists the result, handling conflicts and memory-not-found cases.

nodes.name: _review_audit_handler
nodes.summary: Builds a review-audit tool exposing per-source review counts and public (content-free) audit rows to the agent.

nodes.name: _document_get_handler
nodes.summary: Policy-gated document fetch tool returning a document by id (via document and chunk stores) with required non-empty argument validation.

nodes.name: build_default_agent_tools
nodes.summary: Assembles and binds all default agent tool handlers (with permission/risk profiles) into an AgentToolRegistry given the wired services and stores.

nodes.name: ingestable_source_types
nodes.summary: Returns the tuple of source types that the ingest command can consume.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.summary: Top-level CLI argument parser branching into the search, ingest, event, conversation, people, embedding, memory, workouts, agent and api subparsers.

nodes.name: run_search
nodes.summary: Runs the search command querying the corpus via RetrievalService and rendering matching documents.

nodes.name: run_ingest
nodes.summary: Ingests a single source (document types) into the knowledge database by resolving the source adapter and delegating to the ingestor.

nodes.name: run_event_ingest
nodes.summary: Ingests temporal events (Chrome/YouTube history) from a directory into the event store and prints the summary.

nodes.name: run_conversation_ingest
nodes.summary: Ingests Gemini or ChatGPT conversation exports from a directory and optionally runs memory extraction on the result.

nodes.name: run_people
nodes.summary: Entry point for the people subcommands (index, list, canonicalize).

nodes.name: run_embedding
nodes.summary: Entry point for the embedding backfill subcommand.

nodes.name: run_memory
nodes.summary: Entry point for memory subcommands (extract/curate/review/runs), dispatching to shared CurationRunner wiring.

nodes.name: run_workouts
nodes.summary: Entry point for workout subcommands (import/list/show/exercises).

nodes.name: build_agent
nodes.summary: Canonical production Agent construction path: wires the default tool registry from workspace database stores, enters an OllamaClient, and returns a BuiltAgent holding open resources.

nodes.name: build_chat_memory
nodes.summary: Constructs a ChatMemory with its SQLite memory store for automatic chat recall, persisted at the application layer.

nodes.name: build_chat_people
nodes.summary: Constructs a ChatPeople over the people store for conversational person lookup.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point dispatching parsed arguments to the demo/chat/API paths with logging setup.

nodes.name: load_embedding_settings
nodes.summary: Reads the embedding model name from PERSONAL_AI_EMBEDDING_MODEL; None means embedding is unavailable.

nodes.name: load_retrieval_settings
nodes.summary: Reads retrieval mode (keyword/semantic/hybrid) from PERSONAL_AI_RETRIEVAL_MODE with validation.

nodes.name: load_vision_settings
nodes.summary: Reads vision model and prompt version from their environment variables, defaulting to v2.

nodes.name: load_api_settings
nodes.summary: Reads API host and port from environment with defaults 127.0.0.1:8000.

nodes.name: load_ollama_settings
nodes.summary: Reads the Ollama base URL (OLLAMA_BASE_URL) for the local model backend.

nodes.name: ingest_gemini_conversations
nodes.summary: Ingests a Gemini export directory into the ConversationStore and returns a typed summary; re-running on unchanged sources is idempotent.

nodes.name: ingest_chatgpt_conversations
nodes.summary: Ingests a ChatGPT export directory into the ConversationStore preserving attachment stats and skip diagnostics.

nodes.name: document_from_source_record
nodes.summary: Builds the canonical Document for a SourceRecord, deriving identity exclusively from the stable content-hash helpers and preserving source metadata verbatim.

nodes.name: AgentRegistry
nodes.summary: Duplicate-checked registry mapping agent ids to Agent definitions with deterministic lookup.

nodes.name: SkillRegistry
nodes.summary: Duplicate-checked registry mapping skill names to Skill definitions.

nodes.name: AgentToolRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry of AgentTool definitions bound to handler callables, exposing the tool's permission/risk profile to the policy engine.

nodes.name: ModelCapability
nodes.summary: Enum of task capabilities (simple, research, reasoning, vision, coding, verification) a model is selected for.

nodes.name: ModelRequest
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing a model-selection request with capability, complexity hint, context size, and tool/local-only flags.

nodes.name: ModelSelection
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding the resolved model choice with provider, model name, and fallback flag.

nodes.name: ModelProvider
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol every model backend implements: name() and select(request).

nodes.name: OllamaProvider
nodes.summary: Local Ollama model provider selecting the configured model per requested capability, tracking recent selections for diagnosis.

nodes.name: ModelRouter
nodes.summary: Resolves capability requests to a concrete model via registered ModelProviders, with provider fallback and exception on no available model.

nodes.name: BuiltAgent
nodes.summary: Fully constructed Agent together with its open Ollama client and optional database connection, closed via context manager or close().

nodes.name: BuiltChatMemory
nodes.summary: Constructed ChatMemory together with its SQLite resource, guaranteed closed on completion.

nodes.name: BuiltChatPeople
nodes.summary: Constructed ChatPeople together with its SQLite resource, guaranteed closed on completion.

nodes.name: EmbeddingSettings
nodes.summary: Frozen config dataclass carrying the optional embedding model name.

nodes.name: RetrievalMode
nodes.summary: Enum of retrieval modes (keyword/semantic/hybrid) selectable via environment.

nodes.name: RetrievalSettings
nodes.summary: Frozen config dataclass carrying the retrieval mode.

nodes.name: VisionSettings
nodes.summary: Frozen config dataclass carrying vision model and prompt version.

nodes.name: ApiSettings
nodes.summary: Frozen config dataclass carrying API host, port and chat model.

nodes.name: OllamaSettings
nodes.summary: Frozen config dataclass carrying the Ollama base URL.

nodes.name: GeminiIngestionSummary
nodes.summary: Typed outcome of Gemini conversation ingestion with discovered/stored counts and skipped metadata.

nodes.name: ChatGPTIngestionSummary
nodes.summary: Typed outcome of ChatGPT conversation ingestion including attachment storage counts.
